title: Kyuukyoku Tiger II Plus
overview:
Transcending time, the ultimate tiger now returns!!

A classic that left its mark on arcade history finally comes back to life on the Sega Saturn.

Enemy forces have returned, and two attack helicopter pilots take off to bring them down. Fly through vertically scrolling stages over cities, seas and military bases, destroying ground and air targets until you reach the helipad at the end of each stage.

Shoot carriers to release color-changing power-up icons and switch between three weapons: the balanced Red-Fang, the wide-reaching Blue-Smasher, and a powerful green shot unique to each pilot. Bombs clear everything in their blast, and a full stock lets you power up to a Hyper Bomb. Collect stars along the way for points.

- One or two players at once, each in their own helicopter
- Saturn Mode adds a new stage, CG cutscenes and a new soundtrack

時を越え究極の虎が今甦る!!

アーケードの歴史に残る名作が遂にセガサターンに甦る。
